relevance_note: Case series of three siblings with homozygous GAMT variants: "we describe three siblings with the same homozygous truncating variant in GAMT".
method_note: Read the full paper; a Python script assembled the JSON and copied Table 1 row segments by start/end markers from the paper text (checked against the table by eye). Table 1 has patients as rows with several time-point rows per patient; age fields use the 'Age (months)' column header (quoted as a second span). Features listed in the sentence 'they all showed ...' are recorded for P1-P3 with evidence_basis 'inferred from group statement'. Variant zygosity for P1 and P3 comes from 'The analysis was then extended to her siblings, confirming the same homozygous variant' (named group: P2's siblings). Inheritance left 'not reported' for P1-P3: the paper states both maternal and paternal inheritance (biallelic), which has no single enum value; the statement is in parental_testing_statement. The parents are included as tested relatives (segregation analysis) and labelled relative to P1, the first-listed sibling; the related index for segregation is P2 in the paper's narrative. Parent sex is taken from 'maternal'/'paternal'. Parent zygosity is not stated. 'Family history was negative for neurological disorders' was not used to exclude any specific feature. Normal 3T MRI (Table 1 'Normal'; text 'did not show specific anomalies') is recorded as exclusion of abnormal structural MRI only; MRI checklist items left 'not reported' (D-27). Contradiction: P3 — abstract says 'Neither seizures nor electroencephalographic abnormalities were noted in the youngest brother' and text says serial EEGs showed no focal or paroxysmal abnormalities, but Table 1 lists 'Mild slowing of background activity' for P3; both rows emitted and checklist 'abnormal eeg' set to 'not reported' for P3. P2 had 'no history of epilepsy' at first observation but later developed atypical absences (temporal, not a contradiction); checklist seizures observed. 'Hyposomia' recorded as written without HPO binding. No stacked ' / ' cells; '/' in Table 1 means not performed or not applicable (not reported). Age at diagnosis not stated (P2's GAMT-D was suspected at 2 years; ages at first observation 5 years/31 months/16 months are not diagnosis ages).
